capabilities: Sync the vault bidirectionally with S3-compatible stores using a three-way journal
Resolve conflicts per file with an inline unified diff and keep-this-device/keep-cloud/skip actions
Run syncs on startup, on an interval, or manually via a Sync now command
Create manual snapshot backups under a backup prefix and restore them
Reset local or cloud state by overwriting one side from the other
disambiguation: Not a generic cloud sync; it only connects to S3-compatible object stores (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, custom endpoints) that you configure yourself.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns there is no client-side encryption in v1 (objects stored as-is), that syncing .obsidian/ can expose other plugins' secrets, and that Obsidian 1.13.0+ is required for secret storage. Chinese-language documentation is available in README.zh.md.
motivation: Built for people who want their own bucket, clear conflict handling, and a sync UI that works well on phone as well as desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault to the user's own S3-compatible bucket with clear, per-file conflict handling.

relations.evidence: Portions of the sync engine and S3 transport are adapted from sathinduga/obsidian-s3-sync-and-backup (MIT).

requires.name: S3-compatible object store (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, or custom endpoint)
S3 access key ID and secret access key

summary: Syncs an Obsidian vault to any S3-compatible object store with diff-based conflict resolution and a mobile-friendly sidebar.
